paragraphs.text: Ukkima is a monstrous whale wolf from Ikoria . Its bonder is Cazur .

In addition to their magical bond, Cazur and Ukkima share an unwavering belief in the survival of the fittest. They constantly challenge each other to grow stronger. By combining Cazur’s understanding of combat tactics with Ukkima’s predatory cunning, they’re able to take down enemies neither would be able to handle alone.
